mpis.source: National Bureau of Statistics, Nigeria Multidimensional Poverty Index 2022, Appendix D (Tables D12 and D49) and Table 2
mpis.checks: MPI = sum of weight x censored headcount for every state (within 0.004); no censored headcount above H

indicators.name: Nutrition
indicators.deprived_if: a child under 5 is stunted or underweight, or an adult is underweight

indicators.name: Food insecurity
indicators.deprived_if: the household is severely food insecure (FAO Food Insecurity Experience Scale)

indicators.name: Time to healthcare
indicators.deprived_if: the nearest health facility is 30 minutes or more away on foot

indicators.name: School attendance
indicators.deprived_if: a child aged 6-15 is not attending school

indicators.name: Years of schooling
indicators.deprived_if: no one aged 15 or over has completed primary school

indicators.name: School lag
indicators.deprived_if: a child aged 8-17 is two or more grades behind

indicators.name: Water reliability
indicators.deprived_if: water is available fewer than 20 days a month or 4 hours a day

indicators.name: Sanitation
indicators.deprived_if: the toilet is unimproved, or shared with other households

indicators.name: Housing materials
indicators.deprived_if: the floor, roof or walls are natural or rudimentary

indicators.name: Cooking fuel
indicators.deprived_if: the household cooks with dung, wood or charcoal

indicators.name: Assets
indicators.deprived_if: the household has fewer than two of the listed assets and no car

indicators.name: Unemployment
indicators.deprived_if: a member aged 15 or over is unemployed and looking for work

indicators.name: Underemployment
indicators.deprived_if: a member works under 40 hours a week and wants more

indicators.name: Security shock
indicators.deprived_if: the household suffered a security shock in the past 12 months
